scope: Saiyan Saga #026–050 retained artwork and stable final V3 PNG review completed individually.
method: Each of 25 retained modern images and each of 25 stable final V3 PNGs inspected individually at enlarged size. Final PNG snapshots preserve exactly viewed files; SHA256 hashes match current final outputs. #036 compared to actual local original scan at normal size and enlarged; local boot correction rechecked in final PNG and display WebP. V2 masters #041/#042/#045 rendered and individually inspected for inherited framing limits. Older modern original-artwork assets explicitly not used as original scans. Historical report is evidence only, not a fresh fidelity pass. No contact-sheet blanket approval.
